_comment: H-SRC-001: Verifies query-compression from a long game-news title produces 1-3 short search queries without inventing game names, platforms, or dates not present in the original text.
description: Given a verbose candidate title about a known game event, the LLM query compressor must return concise search queries that preserve only entities present in the source title. The fixture validates that queries are short (<=24 chars, <=3 word gaps), risk_flags catches fabrications, and confidence is reasonable.

input.instructions: Return JSON only. You compress games-news search intent into 1-3 short queries for Chinese social search. Use only provided text. Do not invent game names, dates, platforms, or claims. Prefer game name + event/change. Avoid full sentences, adjectives, clickbait, and filler words.
